name: overlay
description: Overlay services (BRC-22 submit, BRC-24 lookup; docs/OVERLAY.md): the engine judges submissions with the app's topic managers, hands each to the chain app (shruggr/skein-chain, required: chain/1) and admits it on the chain app's answer (accepted or proven), keeps what its topics admitted under <app>/state, and answers lookups, its listings and its documentation as reads (a call over the current state: anyone, signed or not, nothing logged; shruggr/skein#135); a submission is a message {fn: "submit", args: {beef, topics}} into the box <app>/submit (open to anyone), or POST /submit, which carries the same message into that same box and answers its delivery (200 {id}); the submitter is answered by message in its box: admitted (status pending, the STEAK), then each proof, or rejected (shruggr/skein#112); a submission lacking a parent pauses and wants it ({event: "want", txid, topic, peer?}, cleared by "unwant"); tm_demo and ls_demo are its example topic manager and lookup service (ls_demo's index under <app>/ls_demo). Its configuration is config.overlay, read from the app record <app>/app at every step; the install derives its wiring from it: http /submit (a message route: a signed request), the read /lookup, libp2p <topic>, <topic>-admit, <topic>-proof (gossip, #74), and the box <app> from events and from the instance itself (gossiped submissions, peers' admits, its own watch and resume). Topics may also be registered at runtime: {fn: "register", args: {topic, program}} / {fn: "deregister", args: {topic}} from the owner in the app's box register (<app>/register once installed; refused in any other box): the set under <app>/topics; subscribe / unsubscribe events. The owner switches the market and validator roles in the same box: {fn: "market", args: {window} | {off: true}} / {fn: "validator", args: {every} | {off: true}}, kept beside the set, over config.overlay.market / .validator.
